name: std::swap(std::basic_regex)

declarations.code:
template <class CharT, class Traits>

void swap(basic_regex<CharT, Traits> &lhs, basic_regex<CharT, Traits> &rhs) noexcept;

intro: Overloads the std::swap algorithm for std::basic_regex. Exchanges the state of lhs with that of rhs. Effectively calls lhs.swap(rhs).
